title: ResearchOS Source
description: One bibliographic source. Since 2026-10-21 a source in a file not listed in state/cycle_exemptions.json must carry query_id, the search log entry (QRY) that produced it: a source that cannot point at the search that found it is exactly the kind of unsourced addition the citation gates cannot catch. See docs/2026-10-21_hypothesis-cycle-automation.md sections 3 (S1) and 5.

query_id.description: QRY record for the search that produced this source. Required for every source in a non-exempt file; the QRY must also list this source_id in included_source_ids.
